about: The team's issues: tasks a person and their agents can pick up. To pick one up, tell Dinis or the conductor; the conductor records who has it. Rendered on /briefs/ and on each person's brief. Kept by the conductor.

issues.title: Ask the organisers whether a sponsor logo on team clothing is allowed
issues.done: A written yes or no from Web Summit, recorded on the plan. They have already said we can't sell on site.

issues.title: Shortlist 15 to 25 merch sponsor candidates
issues.done: A sourced table (company, why they'd care, who to approach as a role, source and date, fit 1 to 3), with five picked to pitch.
issues.agents: Scout, from the company map and Silvio's network.

issues.title: Pitch and outreach drafts for the top sponsor candidates
issues.done: For each of the top 5 to 10, a one-page business case, a 5-slide deck and a draft of at most 120 words in Silvio's drafts. Silvio sends.

issues.title: Everyone's shirt and hoodie: size, colour, message
issues.done: One line per person (size, a colour no one else has, their message), sent to Sarah. Sizes stay private if anyone prefers.

issues.title: Seven conversation openers for the shirts
issues.done: Seven short lines, one per person, from the openers in brief 3 (do you control your agents? do you know what's on the other side of the agent you're buying?), plus one plainer backup. Sarah and Dinis pick.
issues.agents: Any writer agent can draft them; a person picks.

issues.title: Shirt and hoodie artwork, final
issues.done: Seven colourways of 3 T-shirts each and a hoodie each, with the stand location, the QR and room for a sponsor logo; a plainer backup. Approved by Dinis.
issues.agents: The designer agent prepares mock-ups and the print files; Sarah decides.

issues.title: Quote and order the print run: 21 T-shirts and 7 hoodies
issues.done: Two quotes (a printer in Portugal and a UK next-day option), one order placed, delivery by Fri 6 Nov to someone who'll be in Lisbon. The address stays private.
issues.due: Tue 3 Nov quote, Wed 4 Nov order
issues.agents: The researcher agent finds printers and prices; a person orders.

issues.title: Owners for the 20 priority-1 companies on the map
issues.done: Each priority-1 company has one owner among the seven, recorded on the company map.
issues.agents: The cartographer agent proposes a split by who knows whom; people agree.

issues.title: The card-to-analysis loop, tried on three companies
issues.done: For three priority-1 companies: the company analysis, the risk analysis and how RiskMandate helps, made by an agent in under an hour each, and reviewed by a person. This is what happens to every card at the summit.
issues.agents: Researcher and writer agents, under the team's policies.

issues.title: The RiskMandate offer, packaged
issues.done: What someone buys, at what price, and the page where they buy it from a phone. We can't sell on site, so the buying happens online.

issues.title: Twenty meetings booked before we land
issues.done: About 20 people who'll be at the summit, primed and booked, each with a date, an owner and what we bring. Drafts are written by agents and sent by their owner.
issues.agents: Each owner's agent drafts the outreach.

issues.title: What we bring to each booked meeting
issues.done: For each meeting: their analysis, their risk analysis, how we help, and how they buy.

issues.title: Daniela's agentic team: what it runs, and the policy for each agent
issues.done: A list of agents (website, calendar, email, promotion, lesson preparation before and after) with a behaviour policy for each: what it may read, write and never do. No agent gets free rein of an email account or students' data.

issues.title: Daniela's website, first version
issues.done: A live first version of Daniela's site, built and kept by an agent under its policy, with feedback from Daniela after one round.

issues.title: India's one-off offer, packaged
issues.done: A page with the offer (a website and an agent setup, sold one-off, not as a subscription), the price, and three examples, Daniela's among them.

issues.title: Angela's consulting offer and 10 target companies
issues.done: A one-page offer, and 10 companies from the map (or beyond it, sourced) where the consultancy fits, each with a first-message draft.

issues.title: Vicky's profile page and 10 target employers
issues.done: A one-page profile (what Vicky does, what kind of role), and 10 employers at the summit from the map and the hiring sessions, each with why and a first-message draft.

issues.title: The sessions each person attends
issues.done: For each person, 3 to 6 sessions from the summit page that fit what they want, with the speakers worth meeting.
issues.agents: The curator agent proposes from the summit page; each person picks.

issues.title: The stand on Thursday 12 November
issues.done: The stand location, the rota, what's on the table, and the QR people scan.

issues.title: The merch budget if no sponsor comes
issues.done: A yes from Dinis to pay, and the cut-off for that decision (proposed Wed 4 Nov, 12:00).

issues.title: newsroom.web-summit.sgit.ai: who runs it
issues.done: The human collaborator who runs it, its repository and its DNS; then the conductor bootstraps it from this site.

issues.title: Fill in your card
issues.done: Answers to the questions at the end of your brief, sent to Dinis. Your page on the team shows them.

issues.title: Try the voice memo to follow-up loop once, before the summit
issues.done: One person records a voice memo after a real conversation; within the hour their agent has updated the record, made a page and drafted the follow-up. Recorded on the log.
